answer: Forged identities face a ripple of slashing that propagates to every sponsor in their vine of referrals, so a single fake account drags its whole backing network into penalty. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted reputation slot anchored to a crystal of verified work history: each agent must lock collateral and accumulate attestations from distinct peers before voting. Attackers must fund many independent, reputation-bearing stakes, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
